solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Insect seen in meadow, a spittlebug

indicators.note: the answer is seen lying within the run of clue words that follows

explanation.surface: A naturalist spots a bug among the grasses of a meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: A wasp is a common stinging insect, so it is a straightforward example of the class named.

clue.text: Writer's novel notably lacking drama at the end

indicators.note: novel means new or unusual, so the remaining letters are made into a new arrangement
lacking tells us a letter is missing from the word notably
at the end points to the final letter of drama

explanation.surface: A critic remarks that a writer's new book is short of drama at its climax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at the end' picks A from drama; 'lacking' removes it from NOTABLY, leaving NOTBLY, which 'novel' rearranges. Enid Blyton was a hugely popular British children's author.
explanation.definitionFit: Enid Blyton is a famous author of children's books, so the name is an example of a writer.

clue.text: Set off with it

definitions.meaning: set off as in started a machine or light running
with it as slang for fashionable or alert and aware

explanation.definitionFit: Switching a device on starts it, and someone up to date or alert is colloquially described this way too.

clue.text: Doctor's entertaining chat over a brandy

indicators.note: to entertain is to take in or hold, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: GP, general practitioner, is a family doctor
rap is an informal word for a talk or chat

explanation.surface: A physician chats with a guest over a glass of brandy.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' means that GRAPP sits on top of A.
explanation.definitionFit: Grappa is an Italian spirit distilled from grape pomace, a kind of brandy.

clue.text: Teach group to make a toy

parts.note: to train someone is to teach them
a set is a group of similar things

explanation.surface: An instructor sets a class to build a plaything.
explanation.definitionFit: A model railway sold as a set of track and engines is a classic children's toy.

clue.text: Brew litre in urn

indicators.note: in tells us the litre abbreviation is placed inside the vessel word

parts.note: an urn is a pot

explanation.surface: Someone makes tea by putting a litre of water in an urn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brew' looks like a verb for making tea, but it means to hatch a scheme, as trouble brews.
explanation.definitionFit: To brew mischief is to scheme, and to plot is likewise to plan secretly.

clue.text: Sophisticated socialite being broadcast

parts.note: a deb, debutante, is a young society woman
a programme being broadcast is on air

explanation.surface: A polished young society woman appears on a live show.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair describes a man who is suave, confident and stylish, which is a close synonym of sophisticated.

clue.text: Laughing uncontrollably at home, son with small children

parts.note: someone at home is in
S is the abbreviation for son in family trees
titch is British slang for a small person, especially a child

explanation.surface: A parent is helpless with laughter at home with a son and the little ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in stitches is an idiom for laughing so hard it hurts.

clue.text: Unproductive female's lost grant

indicators.note: lost tells us a letter has gone from the word

parts.note: fallow land is left unplanted and so unproductive
F is the abbreviation for female; the 's stands for has, as in has lost

explanation.surface: A barren woman has had her funding withdrawn.
explanation.definitionFit: To grant something is to permit it, so allow is a synonym in the sense of conceding.

clue.text: Clergyman and a ruler in conflict

indicators.note: letters in conflict are in disorder, so these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A churchman is at odds with a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A rural dean is an Anglican priest supervising a group of parishes, so is a clergyman.

clue.text: Possible reason attempt to secure TT is dashed?

definitions.text: Possible reason attempt to secure TT is dashed?

indicators.note: to secure is to hold in, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: to have a pop at something is to make an attempt

indicators.note: dashed means smashed or scattered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A motorcycle racer's bid for the Isle of Man TT is spoiled by a stop for repairs.
explanation.walkthrough: The TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man; a long pause in the pits could wreck a rider's chances, so the whole clue is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A halt in the pits for fuel or repairs costs time, so it could explain a failed race attempt.

clue.text: Opening bars to Italian anthem

parts.note: the opening bars of a piece of music are its intro

explanation.surface: A piece of music begins with a few bars leading into an Italian national song.
explanation.definitionFit: An introit is a psalm or anthem sung as the priest approaches the altar at the start of Mass.

clue.text: Start clearing away a meal

indicators.note: clearing away means removing, so a letter is taken out

parts.note: to launch something is to start it

explanation.surface: Someone begins clearing the table after a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lunch is the midday meal, a simple example of the general word.

clue.text: Meeting of neighbours in pub overlooking city

indicators.note: in a down clue, overlooking puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: your local is the pub nearest your home
Derby is a city in the English Midlands

explanation.surface: People who live next door gather in a pub with a view over the city.
explanation.definitionFit: A local derby is a match between two nearby teams, a sporting meeting of neighbours.

clue.text: Fool's heartless gibe about one aide

indicators.note: about means around, so the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: an ass is a fool; with the possessive 's that is ass's
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter is removed

parts.note: a gibe is a taunt

explanation.surface: An idiot mocks a helper with a cruel jibe.
explanation.definitionFit: An assistant is someone who helps, the same as an aide.

clue.text: Gradually, heartless boy put in two measures

indicators.note: put in tells us one piece is placed inside the other
two tells us the measure word is used twice

parts.note: a step is a measure taken towards something

indicators.note: heartless means the central letter is taken away

parts.note: a boy is a young male

explanation.surface: A cruel lad is subjected to a couple of measures, little by little.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something one stage at a time is the idiom for progressing slowly, in increments.

clue.text: The Apollo 11 crew had to return to reality

definitions.meaning: the astronauts of the first Moon landing literally had to land back on our planet
to stop daydreaming and face the facts

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for abandoning fantasy and being realistic is also the literal descent of returning astronauts.

clue.text: Awfully game bid to secure ten, an assortment

indicators.note: to secure is to hold, so one piece goes around the other
awfully means badly done, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A poor bid in a card game secures ten tricks with an odd collection of cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awfully' rearranges GAMEBID into MIEDBAG, and 'to secure' places X inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A mixed bag is an idiom for a varied collection, which is what an assortment is.

clue.text: Dried up, comic — embarrassed introducing the man?

indicators.note: introducing means bringing in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a wit is a comic person
someone embarrassed goes red
he is the pronoun for the man

explanation.surface: A comedian dries up on stage and, embarrassed, introduces the next act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dried up' tempts as a comedian forgetting lines, but it is the definition of shrivelled.
explanation.definitionFit: Plants that have withered have shrivelled and dried out.

clue.text: Concise dictionary got out in tavern in horse-breeding centre

parts.note: lex is a short form of lexicon, a dictionary

indicators.note: in tells us the jumbled letters go inside the tavern word

parts.note: an inn is a tavern

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone takes a pocket dictionary out in a pub in horse country.
explanation.definitionFit: Lexington in Kentucky is famous for its thoroughbred stud farms, a centre of horse breeding.

clue.text: Greek character treated with disrespect, reportedly an Adamite

parts.note: nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: reportedly signals that a word is spoken and we hear its sound

parts.note: to diss someone is to treat them with disrespect

explanation.surface: A Greek is mocked, and is said to be one of the unclothed.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamites were a sect who went naked like Adam, so the word names someone who goes unclothed.

clue.text: Key responsibility brings reward

parts.note: B is a musical key
an onus is a responsibility or burden

explanation.surface: A key duty earns a prize.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonus is an extra payment given as a reward.

clue.text: Peer appears during New Year in close

indicators.note: appears during means the noble is placed within the other piece

parts.note: N for new and Y for year are standard abbreviations
an earl is a peer of the realm

explanation.surface: A lord appears during New Year festivities in a cathedral close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close' sounds like a cathedral precinct, but it is used as the adverb meaning almost.
explanation.definitionFit: Close as an adverb means almost, as in close to finished, a synonym in that sense.

clue.text: Support back, terribly sore

parts.note: the back of something is its end

indicators.note: terribly means badly, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone with a sore back needs support.
explanation.definitionFit: To endorse a proposal is to back or support it.

clue.text: Spirit shown by king in most of bad weather?

indicators.note: in tells us the royal letter goes inside
most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: rain is bad weather
K is the abbreviation for king in chess

explanation.surface: A monarch takes a stiff drink to cope with foul weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Raki is an anise-flavoured spirit drunk in Turkey and the Balkans.

clue.text: I'd upset employees, giving stick

indicators.note: upset means turned over, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: a company's employees are its staff

explanation.surface: Someone worries they have offended the workforce.
explanation.definitionFit: A distaff is the stick on which wool or flax is held for spinning.

clue.text: Fellow consumed rejected cheese

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: to have consumed food is to have eaten it

explanation.surface: A man ate some cheese and sent it back.
explanation.definitionFit: Feta is a crumbly white Greek cheese made from sheep's or goat's milk.

clue.text: Horse brought out by Elizabeth after dark

indicators.note: after puts the name piece behind the colour piece

parts.note: black is dark
Bess is a pet form of Elizabeth

explanation.surface: A horse is led out by a woman called Elizabeth at nightfall.
explanation.walkthrough: Black Bess was the horse of the legendary English highwayman Dick Turpin.
explanation.definitionFit: Black Bess is the famous mare of folklore ridden by Dick Turpin.

clue.text: Backed story about one Israeli port

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the reversed word goes round the numeral
backed means turned backwards, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: a tale is a story
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A reversed tale is told about a seaport in Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: Eilat is Israel's port on the Gulf of Aqaba at the Red Sea.
